claims.statement: Tom Allen did not appear at Charles E. Davies' place in Chicago on December 14, 1882, to sign articles for a prize fight with Jimmy Elliott.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen did net appear at Charles E.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he would make no match until after the Sullivan and Elliott fight, and would then fight the winner with bare knuckles or gloves.
claims.excerpt: any match until after the forthcoming fight

notes: The Dec. 14 non-appearance is a separate event from the Dec. 11 one in 670-672 (signing articles, not the forfeit). Davies' place may be the same as 'Parson Davies' place'.
